task: BRD-012 (Subsidiary Management Plan Standards and Content Contracts): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Business rules BRU-012-01 to BRU-012-08 trace to ADR-012 sections 4.1 to 4.5 and 5 and to the ADR-034 section 4.3.1 grammar (one contract, deterministic frontmatter, closed metadata, measured length, stated boundaries, three flag tiers, fixed next step, storage boundary and purity), and stay inside ADR-002 Invariant #2 and ADR-034 Invariant 1.

Metrics are concrete and testable (canonical example parses with full fidelity, zero raises, determinism, zero blocks from Tier B or C, floors never lowered, every combination maps to one next step, zero new record types), except that 'zero inputs make the lint raise' can only be shown over a sampled input set, not exhaustively.

Out of scope excludes Tier A detection, the content hash, the DAG, staleness and the approval gate (ADR-013), orchestration and the legacy removal (ADR-034), per-plan domain rules (ADR-025 to ADR-033), plan quality scoring and route changes, matching the ADRs.

BRU-012-01 to BRU-012-08 are concrete enough to drive an FDD and contract tests. BRU-012-07 (the next step) is stated in prose and made exact as a first-match table in FDD-012; BRU-012-03 route agreement needs the caller to pass the tailoring routes.
